sentences.text: Today, we will talk about Portugal.
Portugal is a beautiful and sunny country in southern Europe.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Portugal?
Portugal is in southwestern Europe.
It is next to Spain and the Atlantic Ocean.
It is part of the Iberian Peninsula.
Portugal also has two island groups.
The Azores Madera, both are in the Atlantic Ocean.
What is the capital city of Portugal?
The capital city is Lisbon.
Lisbon is a colorful city with hills, trams and old buildings.
It is by the sea and the Tagus River.
Other important cities are Porto, famous for its wine.
Faro in the sunny Algarve region.
Coimbra with a very old university.
Braga, Evra, and Funchal.
How many people live in Portugal?
About 10 million people live in Portugal.
Many people live in cities near the coast.
Portugal is a peaceful and friendly country.
What language do people speak in Portugal?
People speak Portuguese.
Portuguese is also spoken in countries like Brazil, Mozambique, and Angola.
Many Portuguese people also speak English, especially in schools and tourist areas.
What is the weather like in Portugal?
Portugal has mild winters and hot summers.
It is one of the sunniest countries in Europe.
In the north, it is cooler and rains more.
In the south, it is warmer and drier.
The islands have mild weather all year.
People enjoy spending time outdoors.
What does Portugal look like?
Portugal has long beaches, hills and mountains, rivers and valleys, olive trees, vineyards, and small villages.
In spring, there are flowers everywhere.
In summer, people visit the coast.
What animals live in Portugal?
Portugal has many animals like foxes, wild boars, and deer, wolves and eagles in the mountains, dolphins and whales in the ocean, cows, goats, and sheep on farms.
In the countryside, you can see birds, frogs, and butterflies.
What do people eat in Portugal?
Portuguese food is fresh, simple, and delicious.
People eat fish and seafood like cotton sardines, rice, bread, and potatoes, vegetables, and olive oil.

Popular dishes include the cow, dried and salted cod, cooked many ways, caldo verde, green soup with potatoes and cabbage, Franciscinha, a sandwich with meat, cheese, and sauce, grilled sardines, popular in summer festivals.
For dessert, pastel dinada, a small egg custard tart, rice pudding and almond cakes.
What do people drink in Portugal?
People drink water, coffee, and tea.
Fresh juice wine.
Portugal is famous for port wine and vinho verde, milk, and sometimes hot chocolate.
Coffee is strong and small, called bica or espresso.
What is life like in Portugal?
Life in Portugal is relaxed and family focused.
People enjoy walking, especially in the evenings, spending time with family and friends, eating together, going to cafes and markets.
Many people work in tourism, agriculture, education, or fishing.
What are some holidays and traditions in Portugal?
Carnival before Lent, with costumes and parades.
Easter with church, food, and family.
Portugal Day, June 10.
Christmas with lights, nativity scenes, and family dinner.
New Year's Eve with fireworks and 12 grapes at midnight.
In summer, towns have local festivals, with music, dancing, and fireworks.
Traditional music includes fado, sad and beautiful songs.
Some fun facts about Portugal.
Portugal is one of the oldest countries in Europe.
The Portuguese flag is green and red, with a coat of arms.
Portugal has the longest bridge in Europe, Vasco da Gama Bridge.
The Portuguese explorers sailed around the world in the 1400s.
People eat more codfish in Portugal than anywhere else.
Now you know many things about Portugal.
You know where it is, what people eat, and how they live.
You learned about the cities, weather, culture, and traditions.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
